cases.summary: Operations professional transitioning into security monitoring with hands-on Splunk, SPL, and network-analysis work. Investigated simulated authentication anomalies, documented indicators, and produced an escalation-ready findings report. Client-service experience adds careful documentation, confidentiality-sensitive communication, and dependable handoffs across time-sensitive work.

Experienced support professional bringing Wireshark packet analysis, DNS troubleshooting, and structured escalation work to network operations. Analyzed a simulated service interruption, isolated the likely failure domain, and prepared a clear technical handoff. Prior customer operations work adds calm communication and precise documentation during time-sensitive issues.

Bilingual support professional with hands-on Python debugging, log review, and network troubleshooting work. Diagnosed simulated connectivity issues, documented findings, and prepared clear escalation notes. High-volume customer communication experience adds patience, accuracy, and dependable follow-through for first-line technical support.

Security-focused professional with hands-on Nessus scanning, remediation, and validation work. Investigated affected software, applied updates in a lab environment, and re-scanned systems to confirm the findings were resolved. Documentation experience adds clear reporting and organized follow-through across remediation tasks.

Cybersecurity-focused professional with hands-on Splunk, Nessus, Python, and network-security projects. Investigated simulated threats, validated vulnerability fixes, and published inspectable technical artifacts. Professional communication experience adds disciplined documentation and concise stakeholder updates across analytical work.
